What the system does

Everything a plant needs — in 4 areas.

Laboratory & Quality
  • Laboratory (LIMS) — assays and CoA in 1 click, reagents, curves, calibration
  • NC / CAPA / Change — deviation becomes 8D corrective action with escalation
  • Risk Management (GRC) — P×S matrix; predicted risk that materializes into an NC
  • Food Safety — HACCP (Codex): hazards, CCPs, auto-deviation
Documents & People
  • Documents (DMS) — current version, character-by-character diff
  • Training — automatic competency matrix
  • Workflows — visual flow and approval designer
Shop floor
  • Production (MES) — consumption, balance, yield, recall
  • Logistics (WMS) — receiving, put-away, shipping, collector
  • Maintenance — automatic preventive and sanitation
Compliance & layers
  • Audit + Suppliers (ISO 19011) — plan, evidence, dossier
  • BI layer — native regulatory analytics (bottlenecks, OOT, performance)
  • Platform layer — multi-company, white-label per tenant

11 integrated modules + 2 cross-cutting layers (BI and Platform) — a single system, all linked.

Why it impresses

It's not a CRUD. It's heavy engineering.

The "invisible" part in a demo — but the most expensive to build and the hardest to copy.

Real analytical engine

Dilution chemistry (3 strategies), 20-digit Decimal precision, every calculation audited with the formula. Requires a chemist + engineer.

Native integration

One data model — not middleware glued by API. It's what makes the system non-substitutable by procurement.

Unit conversion

Mass/volume + density conversion, used by any module (lab, inventory, production).

Cryptographic trail

SHA-256 chaining + Ed25519 signature across all modules, with "meaning of the signature" (21 CFR §11.50).

Isolated multi-tenant

One PostgreSQL schema per company — one company's data inaccessible to another. Base of white-label.

Native regulatory BI

Bottlenecks (TAT p90), OOT, analyst performance — inside the QMS itself, not plugged in later.

Security & integrity

Hardened to the standard the auditor demands.

Passwords & login

bcrypt (never plaintext) + constant-time login (anti email-enumeration).

Brute force

2-layer rate limiting (IP + account) with progressive lockout, before bcrypt.

Sessions

HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookie, 256-bit token, server-side session (revocable).

2FA (TOTP)

Secret encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) + enforcement for admins.

Isolation + RBAC

Isolated schema per company + access control by department and level.

Integrity & files

SHA-256/Ed25519 trail + private uploads (only via authenticated, tenant-scoped API).
